title: DNS resolver disagreement
description: The endpoint's resolver changes from a public resolver to an internal one that answers the same name with a split-horizon address. DNS keeps succeeding, so a naive check reports DNS as healthy, but the answer now points at an address this endpoint cannot reach. The recorder observes the resolver AND the resolved address changing together; Network Bisect can vary the resolver axis and the address axis independently to establish which one changes the outcome.

phases.label: public resolver, public answer, service reachable
internal resolver answers the same name with a split-horizon address
phases.note: DNS still returns an answer, so resolution is not failing. The answer is a different address, and that address does not accept the connection from this endpoint. This is the case a pass/fail DNS check reports as healthy.

phases.label: public resolver restored, public answer returns, service reachable
